non_idle_rule: After every result or interruption, immediately analyze, log, and launch the next experiment. The watchdog recovers only declared queued workers. When the queue is empty, the primary Codex process must plan and enqueue the next experiments. Wait only for an active process, active Codex planning, or required external operation. Stop only on exact top-level STOP.
current_hypothesis: A 500-example direct-filtered Glaive dose may preserve the clean preference-validation improvement observed at 250 examples while giving wider coverage of Glaive decisions. The matched preference-only control scored 0.896111 accuracy and 0.672814 macro F1 on the same 1,800-example clean preference holdout, below the 250-example mix at 0.912778 and 0.685114. Candidate selection will use source-specific clean validation only.
